_files: Paths the chunk may edit. Supports exact paths, 'dir/' prefixes, and * wildcards. live-work/ is included because CLAUDE.md rules 6 and 7 REQUIRE run logs, checkpoint requests and the session handoff to be written there (finding B-1). verify/_tmp-*.mjs and the chunk's OWN main files are declared per the previous scope's carried-forward advice (findings F-6 / DL-1) — the advice was recorded twice and not followed twice, and the guard duly blocked a throwaway probe on 31 July.
_chunk_note: GEOMETRY ONLY: silhouette 186.66 x 48, radius 14px, half-tube rim, swept bevel, slightly convex face RECESSED behind the rim apex. Neutral three-tone diagnostic material. Built in the left margin BESIDE the live CSS grid, never on top of it. ⚠ EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: glass, transmission, environment map, the filament, any light beyond the static diagnostic rig, text on the card, the A-E variants, the logo backdrop, the Next step button, and ANY edit to the five live CSS cards. Those are chunks 2-5.
_budget_note: ⚠ A HALF-TUBE CONSUMES 2R PER SIDE, NOT R — the sweep path is inset by R so theta=pi lands at 2R. The plan's first draft assumed R and its defaults failed its own assertion (face height 24 against a '>50% of 48' guard). Two assertions ship with the geometry: faceHeight >= 0.5 * cardHeight AND faceRadius >= 4. Caught by the plan-review gate, 3 August.
_protected: Approved-foundation and canonical-governance paths the Builder must not touch. Denied unless the same path also appears in 'unlocked'. contact-field-* is listed in full: it is APPROVED and must not move when this card is tuned — the reason the mesh helpers are COPIED rather than imported.
_unlocked: Protected paths Carl has EXPLICITLY authorised for THIS chunk. Overrides 'protected'. Carl's call, not the Builder's.
_unlock_enquiry_opening: Carl: 'unlock authorised', 3 August 2026, after the Builder stated the reason, the exact edit and the residual risk. FOR TWO ADDITIONS ONLY: (1) one import line; (2) one JSX element inside the existing showExtras block, as a sibling of .enquiry-answer-grid, gated on qNum === 5. NOTHING EXISTING MAY BE MODIFIED OR REMOVED. The canvas must mount here because .enquiry-phrase-extras is already absolutely positioned with the answer grid as its first child — a sibling of the shell would inherit none of the shell's translateY(calc(38vh - 5rem)) and would force the y-position to be re-derived from the viewport, creating a second copy of the placement maths (the exact failure contact-field-geometry.ts warns against).
_unlock_risk_accepted: ⚠ THE GUARD IS PATH-BASED AND CANNOT EXPRESS 'ADDITIVE ONLY'. enquiry-opening.tsx holds D-029 (the filament SVG rect) and GRID_REFL (D-031/D-032, the 35-number reflection table), and carries the project's one accepted lint error (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect). The additive-only constraint above is STATED, NOT ENFORCED. ⚠ IT MUST BE VERIFIED BY READING THE DIFF AT CHECKPOINT — the diff should be one import and one element, and anything larger means something has gone wrong. Precedent: the same narrow unlock was granted on 31 July and held.
